facts.fact: Botswana's Minister of Communications and Innovation told Parliament on 18 March 2025 that the Government Accounting and Budgeting System (GABS), after technical faults disrupted payments across all ministries, departments and agencies, was fixed in December 2024 and has since run at full capacity for over 20,000 users without user rationing.

systems.tiers: central government, all ministries, departments and agencies
